notes.title: Patch 1.4.10
notes.content:
We notice all your feedbacks since launch and fix a lot of issues with this patch : 




Interfaces

Domain day and time added to pause menu (only displayed when player is in the Domain)

Visual improvement of the naturon counter in the top right-hand corner of the screen.

Blue indoor/outdoor arrows are now hidden during cutscenes

White interaction circles appear earlier when approaching interactable elements

Fixed scrolling in several menus

Corrected game time displayed on a save slot when a new game is started

Added a distinctive sign in the name of NPCs linked to patrons to better identify them and make it easier to obtain the “Thank you for the support!” achievement.

Corrected character level display when max game level is reached

Fixed joystick icons in game control settings




Puzzles

Fixed a bug in the Academy puzzle that prevented cars from being chronopacked in some cases

Chronopacking a tree when being too close could block the player

Simplification of the first puzzle on the athletics track




Various issues

Improved transitions at the end of cutscenes when they are skipped

Added an “Inventory full” message when retrieving an item if the maximum number has already been reached

Fixed a bug that prevented enemies from reappearing when reloading a level under certain conditions

In the Domain, characters are now healed during the night

Scythe tool cutting speed increased

Various bug fixes and improvements in combat

Various minor bug fixes




Thanks for playing our game, we hope you’ll enjoy it and stay tuned for further patches!

notes.title: Maliki: Poison Of The Past — Live at Games Made In France!
notes.content:
It’s been a few weeks since Maliki: Poison Of The Past launched, and it's time to check back in! Maliki and her quirky little family are making a special stop at the Games Made In France online festival — and you’re invited!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936877/dec71134cb9e3238b2b3f5bff6fcfb81fb9157e9.jpg

Nearly three weeks have flown by since you first answered the call of the Domain and its colorful inhabitants. Ready for a little trip back? Whether you're new or returning, now’s the perfect chance to (re)discover Maliki: Poison Of The Past!

Let’s hit pause, rewind, and jump back to where it all began
Controllers in their hands, Atomium and Trinity will take you on a tour through the game’s unique atmosphere — exploring, farming, and showing off the turn-based combat. The perfect chance to discover (or rediscover) our new RPG!

Bonus treat for the music lovers!
If you’ve been vibing with the game’s soundtrack, good news: the live show will also spotlight the musical creation composed by Starryskyy with a special touch from Motoi Sakuraba... With a little surprise waiting for you at the end of the broadcast...

🗓️ Mark your calendar: May 17 at 3:15 PM (Paris time)
📺 Tune in live: Twitch.tv/mistermv *

*Please note: The stream will be hosted in French

notes.title: Patch 1.3.13
notes.content:
We notice all your feedbacks since launch and fix a lot of issues with this patch : 

Battles
Fixing issue with a freeze during the Frost Golem Fight.
Fixing issue with a freeze during the Twin Golem Fight.
Fixing issue with the MRI fight that let the chrono points gauge locked during battles.
Fixing an issue with the UI on the temporal mist attack.
Fixing white screen issue when launching some fights.
Fixing UI issues when you flee a battle.
Fixing issue when you flee a battle with one character dead.
Fixing issue that let an enemy still visible after his death in battle.
Fixing issue with temporal Aura.
Fixing issues with Toxin and Regeneration that lead to having characters alive with 0 hp or dead with few hp, and the inability to revive the character.
Fixing issue when you start a battle during a dialogue.
Retrying a combat after a gameover will now heal the team.
Minor difficulties adjustment with bosses.
Minor vfx bugs fixes.

Puzzles
Fixing UI issue with Fenimale power icon when she join the group.
Fixing puzzles not set correctly at first loading.
Fixing colliding issue with the background that let the characters stuck. 
Fixing Issue with Fenimale power in the Stadium Puzzle.
Fixing issue with the bumper.
Fixing issue with the spikes when a character stay on it.
Fixing issue with frozen characters when changing characters while entering a puzzle portal.

Various issues
Fixing clock issue in the Domain which affect the plants growth.
Fixing issues that let the enemies frozen when you encounter them.
Fixing issue with the lighter quest that makes the NPC reappear.
Fixing an issue with Bloom FX.

Thanks for playing our game, we hope you’ll enjoy it and stay tuned for further patches!

notes.title: Help us spread the word about Maliki: Poison of the Past on Steam
notes.content:
Dear guardians of the Domaine,

Maliki: Poison of the Past is now available. Huge thanks to everyone who has already played it and shared their feedback.

If you like the game, you can really help us out by leaving a review on Steam. Your ratings play a key role in the visibility of a game on the platform: the more positive reviews a game gets, the greater its chances of being promoted by Steam's algorithm.

Plus, we'd love to chat with you about your adventure!

It only takes a few seconds, and it's a small gesture that can make all the difference for an independent studio like ours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936877/b17fbf179b76a91241e100061847185b171d3c76.jpg
Thanks again for your support,
— The Blue Banshee Games and Ankama Games teams

An all-new combat system, strategic battles where you have to manipulate time, all set in a cute and colorful universe that's perfectly Malikiful—a crazy adventure is about to unfold…
 
Enjoy a 10% launch discount through May 6!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893260/Maliki__Poison_Of_The_Past/

Adventure is calling you, and the Domaine needs you today…

notes.title: Maliki: Poison of the Past : Announcement Trailer!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33221747/3d09ea491e5cc38cc49977fbc5074dd645266c2b.png
 
Longstanding Ankama fans already know the candy pink graphic novel, Maliki !
 
A treat for those who love the Maliki universe, and for everyone, really, the game is developed by the Blue Banshee studio and published by Ankama Games for PC (in French, English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese).
 
Maliki: Poison of the Past is an RPG with turn-based combat set in a cute, colorful universe. In short, it's perfectly Malikiful!
 
An ecological fable… 
…with a new genre of combat! 
 
In the near future, humanity has been corrupted by the evils of the fearsome Poison, which alienates inhabitants and alters the space-time continuum. Luckily, a handful of heroes supported by the famous Maliki have joined forces and are organizing the resistance in the Domaine, the last haven still safe from the threat.
 
Play as Sand on this odyssey through the eras to restore balance and order. Use your Chrono Pack, enter hostile worlds, investigate, and fight hordes of monsters alongside Becky, Fang and Fenimale, a wacky, magical band of characters.
 
Take part in strategic battles in which you'll manipulate time and manage your team to save the world!
 
Use a unique mechanic in turn-based combat: time! Alter time to create ultrapowerful combos and and overcome the fiercest opponents!
 
20 Years of Fabulous Stories 
 
Combining traditional drawing techniques with video game graphic interfaces, Maliki: Poison of the Past will give you a new look at the dynamic, colorful graphic style in the Franco-Belgian graphic novels while infusing it with a touch of Japanese chibi style.
 
[previewyoutube=JVHarL-9kCU;full][/previewyoutube]
 
A touchstone for many readers (you included, perhaps), the graphic novel Maliki is making its first incursion into the world of video games and giving the community a chance to experience Maliki's new adventures in a more intense, immersive fashion.
 
Are you ready to follow Maliki through time and space on her newest adventures?
